name: Trimble Connect API
description:
# Overview
The Trimble Connect API allows you to read, write, and update data into and out of the Connect platform. Now, you can create folders, upload and download files, modify views, and do much more from any application.

Documentation for this service is available on the [Trimble Developer](https://developer.trimble.com/docs/connect/core) site.

# Getting started
**You must agree to the [Terms of Service](https://developer.trimble.com/docs/connect/terms) to use Connect services.**

You need to complete the steps in the [Getting started](https://developer.trimble.com/docs/connect/getting_started) guide to be able to call the API.

# Concepts
Please see [Common Concepts](https://developer.trimble.com/docs/connect#common-concepts) in the Connect Platform documentation.

## Paginated Responses
All collections/lists support a Range header to fetch partial lists (HTTP 206) - the positions are zero-indexed & inclusive

+ Request Header
```
    Range: items=25-34
```

+ Response Header

```
    Content-Range: items 25-34/40
```

## If-Match Header
Some APIs support the If-Match header, especially for changing data on objects. Using this, the API user can ensure that the changes are being done to the latest version.

The APIs that support this header are:

+ **PATCH /folders**
+ **PATCH /files**

## Limits
+ There is a maximum length of 255 characters for project, company, folder, file, group, release, views, and clash names.
+ There is a maximum length of 40 characters for tag labels.
